textBlocks.text: Thank you for participating in our survey! We appreciate your feedback. Please click the arrow to get started.
To verify you are a human, please check the box below.

Cosm is a venue that offers a “Shared Reality” experience where you watch live sports, concerts, movies, and other events together with a crowd of fans on giant, wraparound displays that immerse you in the action.
Cosm is designed to make you feel like you are in the front row of an NBA game or inside a work of art. From a game-winning touchdown to a Cirque du Soleil performance, you share the experience with friends, with no headset needed.
A full bar and menu are available throughout the venue, including alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks, snacks, desserts, and full meals, delivered to your seat.
Cosm has three different spaces:
The Dome: Cosm’s primary Shared Reality experience, a domed theater with an 87-foot-diameter, ultra-high-resolution LED display that surrounds the audience. Seating ranges from high tops and doubles to lounge booths, so you can talk, eat, and enjoy the experience together.
The Hall: A bar and restaurant space with large LED displays showing games and other events, where you can watch with friends and a crowd from tables, booths, or balcony seating.
The Deck: An outdoor terrace with views of the surrounding area, fire pits, and exclusive menu items, where you can relax with food and drinks before or after an event.
